scope.targets: all60 prescribed targets retained; incomplete targets and outcomes remain explicit

interpretation: Four-hour total first-gate execution budget with a fixed deadline four hours after the recorded clock observation. This is elapsed worker execution accounting, not a dollar or vCPU price ceiling.

accounting.aggregation: Sum worker-execution elapsed seconds across all attempts; concurrent workers consume additive elapsed budget
accounting.stop_rule: Stop admission or work when cumulative14400worker-seconds or fixed UTCdeadline is reached, whichever comes first; enforce remaining budget on each admitted execution
accounting.missing_policy: Retain the full60-target plan and record missing, capped or interrupted outcomes; do not replace the denominator with survivors

not_granted: deadline reset for legacy Diem or other work
